title: Escaping model superseded: <START>-only survival framing is obsolete
reality: v2.3.4 stopped HTML-escaping angle brackets in prompt leaf content entirely: character card fields, persona, lorebook entries, memories, and scene text now reach the model verbatim. Explicitly supersedes #3623 and the #3108/hardened-assembly escaping. Structural section wrappers and agent value/attribute escapers are unchanged.
fix: In Common Mistakes (the mes_example bullet), replace the '(v2.3) <START> survives XML prompt sanitization...' sentence with a '(v2.3.4)' note: all prompt leaf content is now verbatim; card authors can use XML-style tags and HTML in card text freely.

title: Prompt field table contradicts fixed editor-order sections (#3817)
reality: v2.3.4 (#3817) made Character and Persona prompt sections keep editor order across preset markers, fallbacks, agent lore, and Game/scene card contexts: Description, Personality, Backstory, Appearance, Scenario, then Example Dialogue when present. The file's table says personality is 'usually appended to description', mes_example appears 'Early in the prompt', backstory 'sometimes / depends on preset configuration'.
fix: Update the table: personality = its own section after Description; backstory and appearance = ordered sections; mes_example = last of the character sections. Add a '(v2.3.4)' note stating the canonical order (#3817).

title: Extension feature removed but Mari section still says she edits browser extensions
reality: v2.3.4 removed the extension feature completely; Professor Mari's extension instructions were removed with it. The 'What Mari can actually do (v2.0)' list still includes browser extensions and the mari db table list includes installed_extensions.
fix: Remove 'browser extensions' from Mari's create/edit list and drop installed_extensions from the mari db table list, adding a '(v2.3.4: the extension feature was removed entirely)' note.
